selected_cli.mode: --print --output-format stream-json --model <exact-model> --trust --mode plan|ask; ask remains admitted only by its existing exact qualified release and read-authority gate.

wire.framing: JSON event per line, each serialized event terminated by LF.
wire.system_init: One initial system/init event must carry a nonempty session_id, the selected model, and permissionMode default.
wire.user: Session identity is validated; event produces no mapped output.
wire.assistant: message.content text blocks are concatenated and projected as output deltas; other content blocks are ignored.
wire.thinking: delta text becomes reasoning progress; completed closes the current thought projection.
wire.tool_call: started/completed with call_id; tool case maps to bounded tool activity; raw tool payload stays private.
wire.result: success with is_error=false, duration_ms, duration_api_ms, nonempty request_id, and result; terminal output must agree with assistant text when both exist.
wire.usage: Optional inputTokens/outputTokens and optional cacheReadTokens/cacheWriteTokens become token usage; malformed counts fail closed.
wire.session: All non-init events must use the initialized session_id.

failure_and_lifecycle.malformed_json_or_selected_fields: typed sanitized failure; stream size/event limits retained.
failure_and_lifecycle.process_nonzero: provider process failure with sanitized diagnostic.
failure_and_lifecycle.cancellation_and_deadline: existing force-stop, wait, join and cleanup path retained.
failure_and_lifecycle.permissions: selected default permissionMode and existing plan/ask/read-write selection unchanged; no inferred provider enforcement.
